title: Sidebar
description: Trimmed port of the shadcn sidebar, inset variant only, icon collapse only. Compound component: the consumer arranges named parts as JSX; each part owns its own chrome. Nav items render router links via asChild; active styling keys off aria-current="page".

anatomy.description: Owns open/collapsed state (controlled or uncontrolled) and exposes it through useSidebar. Sets the width custom properties on the wrapper.
The navigation column; data-state="expanded|collapsed" drives the collapse animation.
Mini discrete Button that toggles the sidebar; the label is visually hidden with the global sr-only class.

The main content surface beside the sidebar, rendered as <main>. It is the page's only scroll container — the wrapper is viewport-height and clipped, so the document never scrolls — with the house subtle scrollbar and a reserved left gutter for the floating trigger; sticky toolbars and headers inside it pin to its top edge, and the router restores its scroll position.

Zero-height sticky anchor at the top of the inset that floats the SidebarTrigger in the inset's reserved left gutter (--sidebar-inset-gutter, 3rem), so the toggle stays present while the inset scrolls and shares a row with sticky toolbars and table headers without any offset.
A labelled cluster of menu items.
The nav list. SidebarMenu draws a sliding indicator shaped as an inset-connector tab under the active item; SidebarMenuButton slots a router link with asChild or renders a react-aria Button.

usage: Wrap the layout in SidebarProvider; render Sidebar and SidebarInset as siblings inside it.
Scrolling happens inside SidebarInset, not the document: size sticky offsets against the inset's top edge, and never rely on window.scrollY.
Sticky content inside the inset pins to top: 0; the floating trigger lives in the inset's left gutter, so nothing needs to offset for it.
Mark the active item with the router's aria-current="page" (or data-active); the indicator observes both and needs no router coupling.
Collapsed-rail labels need no tooltip component: the row's own label is repositioned and revealed on hover/focus by CSS, so the accessible name stays on the button.
Deliberately not ported: floating/right variants, offcanvas mode, the mobile sheet, rail/input/separator, badges, submenus, cookie persistence, keyboard shortcut.
